items.sentence: What makes a long sentence difficult ___ often not vocabulary but its hidden structure.

recall.q: what절 전체가 주어일 때 어떻게 봅니까?

items.prompt: 첫 번째 was와 수일치를 판단할 주어 중심부를 드래그하세요.
items.sentence: In 2015, the number of Chinese people mostly buying Korean cosmetics brands was greater than that of Chinese people mostly buying Chinese brands, and ‘Good word of mouth’ was the biggest decision factor for those who purchased Korean brands.
accepted: the number of Chinese people mostly buying Korean cosmetics brands
items.hint: 첫 번째 was 앞에서 수를 결정하는 중심부를 찾습니다. 핵심은 the number입니다.
items.ruleHtml: the number of + 복수명사 → 핵심은 number

recall.q: the number of people의 수를 결정하는 핵심어는?

items.sentence: In 2015, the number of Chinese people mostly buying Korean cosmetics brands was greater than that of Chinese people mostly buying Chinese brands.
items.hint: people 뒤에서 ‘어떤 사람들인가’를 덧붙이는 부분만 묶어 보세요.

items.sentence: Purchasing local produce not only ___ the local economy, but it also helps you save money on food and get high-quality fruits and vegetables.

items.prompt: 이 문장의 첫 번째 주어를 드래그하세요.
items.sentence: Purchasing local produce not only improves the local economy, but it also helps you save money on food and get high-quality fruits and vegetables.
items.hint: improves 앞에서 ‘무엇이 개선하는가’를 하나의 행동 덩어리로 찾으세요.

items.sentence: Europe’s first Homo Sapiens lived primarily on large game, particularly reindeer; however, even under ideal circumstances, to hunt these fast animals only with spear or bow and arrow was an uncertain task for them.
items.hint: 첫 번째 동사 lived의 앞에서 주어를 찾으세요.

items.prompt: was의 주어가 되는 to부정사구 전체를 드래그하세요.
items.sentence: Even under ideal circumstances, to hunt these fast animals only with spear or bow and arrow was an uncertain task for them.
items.answer: to hunt these fast animals only with spear or bow and arrow
items.hint: 문장 앞의 부사구는 잠시 제외하고, was 앞의 행동 덩어리를 찾으세요.

items.sentence: That legalizing euthanasia is a thorny issue is a well-known fact: Is it a right to die with dignity or a crime that violates the dignity of human life?
items.answer: That legalizing euthanasia is a thorny issue
items.hint: 문장 전체의 본동사는 두 번째 is입니다. 그 앞의 that절 전체를 묶어 보세요.

items.prompt: 문장 전체의 주어가 되는 what절을 드래그하세요.
items.sentence: What distinguishes humans from animals is that the former make tools and, as civilization progresses, these tools gradually turn into machines.
items.hint: 문장 전체의 본동사 is를 먼저 찾고, 그 앞의 명사절을 하나로 묶으세요.

items.prompt: is not clear의 주어 범위를 드래그하세요.
items.sentence: Although humans have been drinking coffee for centuries, where coffee originated or who first discovered it is not clear.
items.answer: where coffee originated or who first discovered it
items.hint: Although절은 잠시 제외하고, 두 의문사절이 or로 연결된 전체 범위를 찾으세요.
items.ruleHtml: 의문사절 + or + 의문사절 → 하나의 주어 덩어리

items.sentence: Whoever has a high sense of self-efficiency tends to pursue challenging goals and may be more willing to step outside the culturally prescribed behaviors to attempt tasks or goals for which success is viewed as improbable by the majority of people in a setting.
items.answer: Whoever has a high sense of self-efficiency
items.hint: 첫 번째 본동사 tends 앞의 복합관계대명사절 전체를 묶으세요.

items.prompt: and가 연결하는 두 술어의 중심을 차례로 드래그하세요.
items.sentence: Whoever has a high sense of self-efficiency tends to pursue challenging goals and may be more willing to step outside the culturally prescribed behaviors.
items.hint: 주어 뒤의 첫 번째 술어 중심과 and 뒤의 두 번째 술어 중심을 찾으세요.
items.ruleHtml: tends … and may be … → 병렬 술어

items.prompt: tasks or goals를 꾸미는 관계사절을 드래그하세요.
items.sentence: Whoever has a high sense of self-efficiency tends to pursue challenging goals and may be more willing to step outside the culturally prescribed behaviors to attempt tasks or goals for which success is viewed as improbable by the majority of people in a setting.
items.answer: for which success is viewed as improbable by the majority of people in a setting
items.hint: tasks or goals 바로 뒤의 for which부터 문장 끝까지 묶으세요.

items.sentence: Reading difficult texts every day improves your ability to see sentence structure.
items.hint: improves 앞의 하나의 행동 덩어리를 찾으세요.

items.prompt: 처음과 같은 원리입니다. 어법상 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
items.sentence: What matters most when a sentence becomes long ___ finding its main structure first.
